title: Developers don't understand CORS (2019)
summary: A 2019 blog post explaining common misconceptions developers have about CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing), clarifying how it actually works versus how it's perceived, with practical examples to help developers understand browser security policies.
problem_solved: Clarifies the common misunderstanding that CORS is a server-side security feature, when it's actually a browser-enforced policy protecting users.
why_valuable: Helps developers avoid frustration and security mistakes by properly understanding CORS, which is essential for building web applications with cross-origin requests.
